title: Court listing: M. Vasquez
body:
A county court listing dated 8 February 2026 records a hearing in a contractual dispute
involving a party named M. Vasquez. The listing includes a residential address at 41
Richmond Road and a date of birth of 14 March 1979.

The dispute concerns an unpaid invoice of 4,200 pounds and is unrelated to any criminal
proceeding.
